rawContent: In the wake of the #MeToo movements, this is a time for women to remove other women, who lie, cheat, and backstabbing other women (and men).
Those women, who are exploiting women's movements for personal, selfish gains. #MeToo!
So, as I am hearing more discussions, surrounding the #MeToo movement, I have A LOT on my mind, concerning experiences I have had, am currently having, here in Cairo, Egypt.
I am going to use my twitter platform to speak out on it. #MeToo

If you are a TRUE FEMINIST, and claim to really be down for women's rights, and not monopolizing the women's movements, for your own selfish gains, you won't be ''offended,'' by what I have to say. #MeToo
In my matriculation throughout Cairo, while being in a committed relationship with a Black man (from Cameroon), I have further been immersed into how BLACK LOVE is forbidden! #MeToo
And, I am not talking about Black couples who have a conquered slave mind. I am talking about Black people, who come from strong cultures, and are madly in love. #MeToo

I have had numerous experiences of Egyptian-Arab women, White, Asian, and 1 Latina woman trying to come and disrespect our relationship, trying to seduce my partner in front of me (even in CHURCH), and trying to get my partner to disrespect me. #MeToo

In their sick, sadistic, narcisstic, egotistical, racist minds, assisting in the destruction of loving, healthy Black relationships/couples, helps them to maintain their mentalities of ''superiority,'' against me. #MeToo
These same women will be QUICK to cry rape or sexual harassment against Black African, or Black American men, the moment he does not do what they say, or break away from their power. #MeToo
This happened to an ex-boyfriend of mine, a half Ugandan/half South Sudanese man. #MeToo
An Egyptian-Arab woman, who was mad that he did not do what she ordered him to do, or have sex with her, as she wanted him to, went to the police, to say that he sexually assaulted her. LIAR! #MeToo

These incidents have happened to Black American men, who have engaged in social relations with Egyptian-Arab women.  Black American men getting locked up, because an Egyptian woman says that he tried to rape her. #MeToo
Three weeks ago, I am on the bus with my partner.  Two, young, Egyptian Arab women come to sit behind us.  Sitting next to them is an Egyptian-Arab man, who was collecting the money. #MeToo
He was sitting RIGHT NEXT TO THEM.  So, the girl who had the money, could have EASILY given a man from her culture, the bus fare for she and her friend. #MeToo

As opposed to doing that, she reaches over, and tries to get my man to take the money. In her mind, despite him being with me, HIS WOMAN, he was her African slave boy, and she wanted to assert her power. #MeToo

I knocked her hand away, and told her to give it to the man, next to her. She and her stupid friend started giggling, but got quiet, when I told them that I'll resolve this when we get off the bus. #MeToo

They got off an earlier stop than we did, but I whispered to one of the women, ''whore.'' I don't feel bad for saying it, either. I could see the discomfort when they got off the bus, and they deserved it. #MeToo
Please note, that I am a feminist and womanist! I have been in the women's movement since I was in college.  But, this other toxic culture, must be addressed, and I won't back down from it! #MeToo
And, as a BLACK AMERICAN woman, our experiences have been different! Our foremothers and their experiences were different! #MeToo
Please note the incident I described has occurred on more than one occassion.  What stopped these women from having power or dominance over my partner, was MY PRESENCE. #MeToo
A presence, which THEY DESPISE, because my Black American, female image, does not embody the role of the slave, or maid, that many are used to seeing here in Cairo. #MeToo

In their racist minds, #BlackLove and Black relationships are not to be respected or taken seriously. #MeToo The conquest mentality of having over Black people, despite the oppressions they experience in this country, as women.

You have a number of Egyptian-Arab, European, White American, or non-Black women, who get a THRILL off of feeling that they can break up a Black couple.  THRILLED to see a Black man demean a Black woman for them. #MeToo
These women ENJOY and love the thrill of seeing Black women run after them, or disrespect their Black wives or Black, female partners for them. #MeToo

They LOVE to feel as if they have power over Black men, and get INDIGNANT when that doesn't happen.  Some become more persistent in going after Black men. Don't care if he has a partner, either. And them having a Black woman wife or partner, makes it more ''enticing'' #MeToo

For them, going into Black communities, assisting to destroy Black relationships, or assisting Black men in demeaning Black women, gives them the validation of being ''superior,'' against Black women. #MeToo

There was even an incident I experienced, where an Egyptian-Arab mother, and her two daughters,'' was mocking me and my partner, on the bus.  Here we are, minding our business, and she wants to start mess. #MeToo

Because my man was not bowing down to her, as her dutiful, African slave boy, and was paying attention to me, she had to find a way to symbolically demean our relationship, in order to cope with her ''superiority,'' against me, being challenged. #MeToo

When seeing that I was in a committed relationship, Sabine Platter, Martina Helmy, the other devilish woman, and Catherine Moustafa, had to find a way to demean my relationship, the last time I was a member of the Cairo Chorale Society. #MeToo

They had to find a way to subconsciously prove to themselves that their ''White womanhood,'' or half-White womanhood,was ''superior,'' to me.  Despite the fact that I never did a thing to them, and was always nice to them.  Even took beautiful photographs of them. #MeToo

What makes this different from group of West African women, 4 Black American women, who were overtly disrespectful (though, their presence is for an interesting analysis) is the racial component. The hierarchy in the context of womanhood and racial superiority. #MeToo

@MRogersWrites It is IMPORTANT that the #MeToo movement ADDRESS these issues as well.  Because there are women trying to exploit the movement.  It's why you have this other group of women, who are making a backlash against it.
@MRogersWrites There are women in the #MeToo movement, who will silence Black women being abused in our own communities, but will use Black men for support against the sexism they face.
Healing will not come into the world. . .JUSTICE for women, will not come into the world. . .UNTIL. . .WOMEN start treating each other, better! #MeToo

I'm sick and tired of this toxic culture, and silent aggression, happening in too many women's circles.  In my experiences, I have learned that MEN treat WOMEN, based on how they SEE WOMEN treating WOMEN, or little girls. #MeToo
I have experienced MEN becoming confused and even ashamed, when they saw me not entertain their disrespect of other women.  #MeToo

Why was it strange for them, to see this different reaction, by a woman? Because they were used to being around OTHER WOMEN, who encouraged such sentiments or behaviors against women, in order for them to feel like they were the ''Queen Dame,'' or the woman that #MeToo
he found to be. . .''the best.'' #MeToo
When an Egyptian-Arab man tried to talk trash about Egyptian-Arab women, he felt bad and embarassed when I showed him that I was offended, and wasn't appeased by that mess. #MeToo

When a man, I went on a dinner date with, revealed to me that he was married and had a Baby, I left his sorry behind at the restaurant, looking stupid. Took myself home, cussed him out, and hung the phone up on him, when he tried to call me after 2 weeks. #MeToo

But, why was he shocked and surprised?  BECAUSE there would have been other women, who would not have cared that he was married, would have allowed him to take them on other dates, and would have allowed him to call them.  That's why! #MeToo
It's time to START incorporating #MySistersKeeper inside of the #MeToo movement!

There are women, who target married men, thus participating in the abuse and detriment of other women, try to exploit these men, for money and power.  That is NOT  feminism! It's time for #MeToo to start address this! #MySistersKeeper
@MRogersWrites Ok.  Give me a day or two, and I will forward you some things.  We can start our conversations, there. #MeToo

In many incidents, if I was not there, non-Black women, here in Cairo, Egypt would have tried to use their racial privilege to have power over my man.  And would have threatened to have reported him to the police, if he didn't do what they said.  Including having sex with #MeToo
them, because of the illusions and images of the Black, male stud/hunk, and his sexual prowess. #MeToo

That includes the wife of my rent manager, who dismissed my presence, and tried to get more money from my partner, when she thought I wasnt around.  I called her a whore, as well. Because she is. #MeToo

Sending three men to my home, when my partner was around, to try and bully him.  Doing this at 9-10 pm.  When I tell you that the whole neighborhood came out, after seeing that I was about to kick their behinds, I'm not playin.' #MeToo

For her to even speak to another man, outside of her husband, is forbidden in her society.  But, because my man is a Black African man, she feels that she has the power to do such; despite the fact, that she is a woman in a male dominated society. #MeToo
She is a cowardly, piece of trash, who can't face me, but sends her husband or men to try to start mess. Instigating mess because she is mad that my man is with a Black woman! #MeToo

Ain't that some mess?  He is not Egyptian.  He's not Arab.  He's not Muslim, but she thinks she has the right to send abuses against our relationship.  Because she sees our presence as a ''defeat,'' against her notions of racial superiority. #MeToo
She used to laugh at my presence.  Let's just say that I wiped that smile off her face. #MeToo
There are other Egyptian-Arab women, who don't have an issue with my presence.  They do see me as a loving person, because I acknowledge their presence. #MeToo
Any non-Black woman, who tries to erase my image in my own culture, in order to proclaim herself as the feminine image of my culture, is NO SISTER to me! #MeToo

That includes those particular trashy women, whether at AUC, or off campus, who thought it was alright to celebrate Black History month, without connecting with me, and thinking they were ''out doing,'' me in my own culture; OR having African slave-minded women, who  #MeToo
their notions of racial superiority, and stealing a culture and holiday that is not theirs, because they are trash, and can't do their own, is NO SISTER to me; #MeToo

Black American, Caribbean, or African women, who want to be combative, always trying to challenge other Black women (whether, feeling like they can take away their man, opportunities, or others), while acting like slaves in the presence of non-Black women, and #MeToo

are not doing the WORK to build up their own communities, so that they have the POWER to barter with other cultures and races of other women, are NOT sisters of mine. And, I could care less if they stay maids and slaves. #MeToo

Non-Black women, and their organizations, who steal BA women's culture, and then try to remove BA women maidens, like myself, who were doing the WORK of sustaining our culture, ARE NOT Sisters of mine. #MeToo
Non-Black women, who cry #MeToo and then SUPPORT Black men's debasement, oppression, invisibility, and silencing of Black women are TRASH, and are not my Sisters! #MeToo

Black American women who support Black American, male patriarchy, bow down before BA men, and then come to Egypt trying to break up a relationship of a fellow Black American women are TRASH, and are not my Sisters! #MeToo
African women who support Black American men's debasement, invisibility, and marginalization of Black American women are TRASH, and you are not my Sisters! #MeToo

Non-Black women who enter into my community or use the culture/music, that was birthed by my foremothers, and is continued by Black American maidens, yet despise OUR PRESENCE in our own GARDENS, you are LOWER than TRASH! You are NOT my Sisters! #MeToo
Women who lie, deceive, and manipulate my tweets and words, on purpose, in order to say that I am anti-woman, or not for women's rights, ARE lower than trash§ #MeToo

Women like Catherine Moustafa, who can forward e-mails, where I address another woman's disrespect behaviors towards my partner, yet didn't use that same energy to arrange a meeting, so that we can resolve the issue, because she wanted to get rid of me, but try to extract #MeToo
whatever financial resources, or gains, she thought she could get from my partner; as opposed to us bring together our creative auras, as women are TRASH! #MeToo

To those loving women, of different cultures, races, religions, who have shown me love. . .whom we have built gardens, together, AND who we continue to honor the traditions of the feminine, our womanhood, as we continue to heal our world. . .YOU are my SISTERS! #MeToo
And, I am GRATEFUL for women like you, for your company, and for the fact that the Universe, has blessed me with your presence! #MeToo

And for those of you all, who are monitoring my tweets, and don't like what I have to say, and go to tell people in authority what I am writing, it's because YOU DO, the very things that I have articulated!  You just HATE that I called you out, for it! #MeToo

Martina Helmy, Sabbine Platter, and your other devil friend, you are TRASH! I know the first week of last semester's rehearsal was a BIG DISAPPOINTMENT for you, when my man didn't show up at rehearsal.  Your plans for using the African hunk, for your ego and appeasement #MeToo

shriveled fast, didn't they? That's why Catherine Moustafa sent me me an e-mail on dues that I owe CCS, even though I already sent her an email about how much I owed! Trying to act powerful, but that was the only way she could vent her frustrations, that the plan #MeToo failed.
Ladies, IT'S TIME to CLEAN UP the #MeToo movement! I can't roll with ya,' if we don't address the hypocrisy, happening.  And, it is happening more than what we think!

And those of you, who love usingthat ''angry, Black woman,'' image, who accredit to me, that, too, is getting stale.  Women all over the world, are awaking up to a new feeling, for those of us personifying, Dark Mother. #MeToo
Black American, African, Caribbean, and those Black women, who exploited the image, and power of Dark Mother, you, too, will be left behind. #MeToo
European, Asian, Latina, Arab, African, American, and others who exploited the image and power of Dark Mother, you, too, will be left behind. #MeToo
The Earth and Universe are working together to stifle the power of those feminine beings, who are not using their energies to sustain harmony and balance in the world.  #MeToo
Masculine energies and beings, who are wanting to cause destruction and harm, will also be, stifled. Times are changing. #MeToo And, no amount of money or power, that you have, will stop it!
Healing and balance is about to take place in our world! #MeToo

African, Black American, Caribbean, and other Black women, who created spaces of balance, nurture, love, and healing; reminding other women of their power, get ready for our images to be RESTORED! #MeToo
Trashy, gutteral women like to use the police and women's movements to assert power over others. #MeToo They get offended when their behaviors are challenged.

Trashy, gutteral women love the feeling of using women's movements, the police, and other entities to abuse other women, and even men! They want the power of feeling like they can behave any way they want to, and getting away with it! #MeToo

I support the liberations and rights of women, in connection to Universal law, and feminine energy and power. #MeToo

Trashy, gutteral women, will mistreat their good husbands, badly.  While he is working to prepare a great life for them, and the children, they will have their side lovers.  And, then they will try to go after other women's partners/boyfriends/loveers, as what happened #MeToo

at Holy Family of Maadi Catholic Church.  There are women of the French congregation, 1 Cote D'Ivorian, and 1 from Burkina Faso, who did that mess. It was covered up and protected, by other women. Trash! #MeToo
These same women will use women's rights laws and court systems to get more money from their husbands, whom they cheated on! Using the children, as weapons and as leverage! #MeToo

Ain't that right, Catherine Moustafa, Director of Membership for CCS? #MeToo
Alright.  I had a greeat walk. Some more beautiful Souls! Men and women. Can't wait to see my Sisters of the Garden, this week! Let's get it! #MeToo

Let's also make it clear, that the abuse of women, especially those who are caring for their communities, have beautiful Spirits, and are being exploited. . .IS WRONG! I don't support male egos, and women who support this kind of hypermasculinity! #MeToo

So, Amandla Awethu continue to reiterate over and over and over again that drugging women is rape, and that is wrong. She reiterates this, even though I had made it CLEAR in one of her responses that Cosby took power, by drugging the women.  #MeToo

are not important or have minimal value. #MeToo

woman, her connection to sexuality, it's role in sustaining life, and how it is to serve as a HEALING tool for MEN and WOMEN. #MeToo

I did the work of introducing myself to them asking their names, trying to get to know them, checking up on them; asking how their tour at the pyramids was ,and etc. #MeToo

After our first and only dinner with the group, these women continued in their persistence to get us to come back, to have dinner. Getting the male leader of the group to invite us for dinner. #MeToo

I gave her my number, as a reminder that we can link up.  Yet, she chose to linger around, with a man she did not know, as opposed to link up with a fellow foreign woman, who has experience in the country, and is active. #MeToo

Because she did not value me as a woman, and was more interested in getting male attention, even if from a middle-aged stranger, she continued to stay with the man, and speak with him on sexual harassment. #MeToo

She showed no interest in connecting with Egyptian women, and the events that were happening, which reflected their culture and womanhood.  I could have gotten her a ticket to the @EntreprenelleME event. #MeToo

Why? Because she valued men, more.  The solution walked passed her.  If something were to happen, she would have talked more about how bad the men behaved.  Yet, she dismissed women's spaces for a man. #MeToo
You want another story? #MeToo

I gave her one of my colleague's contacts.  Yet, I told her to wait, so that I could plan her trip. #MeToo

As a woman, and woman from her culture, I served as a link of protection.  Yet, she decides to book a flight to Aswan (without telling me), and calls my then colleague at 9:15pm to let him know that she arrived in Aswan. #MeToo

When he called me to let me know, as this was surprising to him (keep in mind that he is married with a baby), I told him to block her number. Then, I called her to tell her that she was on her own.  Since she wanted to sneak down to Aswan, thinking she is going to #MeToo
have fun, with my colleague, and didn't wait on me to organize her trip-rather, just wanting to use me to try to get male attention and companionship, I let her know that she was ON HER OWN. #MeToo
The Black Canadian woman never called me. #MeToo

Despite speaking against sexual harassment, rape, and sexual assault against women, by men, I can't help, BUT to notice how there is a GREAT AURA of anti-women sentiments in women's movements.  Whether women will acknowledge this, or are aware of it, or not. #MeToo

and sacrificing other women to do so. #MeToo

Which meant having power, and ruling, in patriarchal setups.  Being able to dominate like the men. #MeToo
